title: Security Deposit Account Fob Count When the Final Statement Is Late
content:
**Rule.** A late final account statement on a Security Deposit Account changes how the countable fobs on an unreturned-fob line are reckoned. The lateness is measured in calendar days from the move-out date to the statement date.

- **More than 25 days:** the countable fobs are halved and rounded down to a whole fob.
- **More than 20 but no more than 25 days:** one fob fewer than the countable fobs is charged, never fewer than none.
- **20 days or fewer:** the countable fobs are charged as counted.

The 20 days are the program's service-standard days for issuing the statement, which are 20 on every deposit program.

**Records read.** The move-out date and the statement date on the deposit account.

## Ladder

| Days from move-out to statement | Fobs charged |
|---|---|
| 26 or more | half the countable fobs, rounded down to a whole fob |
| 21 to 25 | the countable fobs less one, never below none |
| 20 or fewer | the countable fobs |

## Boundary and worked cases (hypothetical, move-out 1 May, 5 countable fobs)

| Statement date | Days | Fobs charged |
|---|---|---|
| 21 May | 20 | 5 |
| 22 May | 21 | 4 |
| 26 May | 25 | 4 |
| 27 May | 26 | 2 (half of 5 is 2.5, rounded down) |

With 0 countable fobs and a statement 23 days after move-out, none are charged.
